H1.fail_rule: the paired interval is below zero; overlap with zero is inconclusive
H1.pass_rule: paired 95% interval for ThetaShield minus fixed-fee LP net PnL is above zero
H1.title: LP protection

H2.fail_rule: a lower interval exceeds either limit; boundary overlap is inconclusive
H2.pass_rule: upper intervals stay within 10% of baseline mean fee and 5% false positives
H2.title: Benign-flow fairness

H3.fail_rule: the paired interval is non-positive; overlap with zero is inconclusive
H3.pass_rule: paired 95% interval for raw-markout minus ThetaShield false-positive rate is above zero
H3.title: Noise robustness

H4.fail_rule: rank correlation is non-negative or fewer than two Pareto points exist; other results are inconclusive
H4.pass_rule: rank correlation is at most -0.35 with at least three Pareto points spanning 5 percentage points and 5 steps
H4.title: Detection trade-off

H5.fail_rule: either reduction is non-positive or retained coverage is below 25%; intermediate evidence is inconclusive
H5.pass_rule: ThetaShield reduces raw-markout false positives and oscillation with lower intervals above zero while retaining at least 50% toxic-premium coverage
H5.title: Manipulation resistance

H6.fail_rule: the advantage is non-positive or correlation is at least 0.95; intermediate evidence is inconclusive
H6.pass_rule: ThetaShield's paired correct-direction advantage is at least 20 percentage points and mean volatility-fee correlation is at most 0.80
H6.title: Directional discrimination

method: deterministic one-at-a-time sweep around the committed Phase 5 default
